methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Virginia Tech research team gets $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
signals.signal_reading: A $20M cloud-based semiconductor lab at Virginia Tech creates deep technical capability in New River Valley, but the cloud-based research infrastructure may enable distributed access patterns if designed for statewide collaboration rather than campus-only concentration.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab signals intentional distribution of AI literacy beyond metro hubs, creating peer learning networks in smaller markets—precisely the mechanism that enables deep-and-distributed capability if sustained and replicated.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops by a Norfolk native targeting the Hampton Roads technology gap demonstrate grassroots, community-driven AI fluency development—the distributed peer network model that could counter metro concentration if scaled.

signals.title: Google to invest millions for Virginia workforce development amid data center growth - wric.com
signals.signal_reading: Google's workforce development investment tied to data center growth suggests shallow, platform-mediated AI adoption focused on operating infrastructure rather than developing deep technical capabilities—broad reach without deep roots.

signals.title: Internet provider ZiTel approved to finish broadband deployment work in Patrick, Franklin, Henry counties
signals.signal_reading: Broadband deployment struggles in Patrick, Franklin, and Henry counties reveal infrastructure gaps that prevent even shallow AI adoption—without basic connectivity, Southside risks exclusion from both distributed and concentrated AI development pathways.
